facts.claim: The population of Jagtial Town in 1901 was 11,181.
Karimnagar Town contains a District jail and a tannery.
facts.quote: a District jail, and a tannery.

facts.claim: Koratla produces paper of a coarse texture used by patwdris for account-books.
facts.quote: Paper of a coarse texture is made, whjch is largely used by the patwdris for their account-books.
